---
title: "Google Apps Scripts and Javascript"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

files <- sort(list.files("random-files/GAS+JS/", pattern = "\\.md$", full.names = TRUE))
for (f in files) {
  name <- basename(f)
  display <- sub("\\.md$", "", name)
  cat(sprintf("- [%s](%s)\n", display, f))
}
```
